meaning.en: Narada, approaching the Lord, asked
meaning.hi: नारद ने भगवान के पास जाकर पूछा

meaning.en: what is this path of the Paramahamsas
meaning.hi: परमहंसों का यह मार्ग क्या है

meaning.en: exceedingly rare in the world, not common
meaning.hi: संसार में अत्यंत दुर्लभ, सामान्य नहीं

meaning.en: he alone is forever established in purity
meaning.hi: वही सदा शुद्ध स्थित है

meaning.en: he alone is the Vedas in human form
meaning.hi: वही वेदपुरुष है

words.sanskrit: mahapurusho yat chittam sarvada mayy eva avatishthate

meaning.en: the great soul whose mind always rests only in me
meaning.hi: महापुरुष जिसका चित्त सदा केवल मुझमें स्थित रहता है

words.sanskrit: tasmad aham cha tasminn eva avasthiyate

meaning.en: therefore I too remain established in that same person
meaning.hi: इसलिए मैं भी उसी में स्थित रहता हूँ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: one's own son, friend, wife, and relatives
meaning.hi: अपने पुत्र, मित्र, पत्नी और बांधव

meaning.en: renouncing tuft, sacred thread, study, and all rites
meaning.hi: शिखा, यज्ञोपवीत, स्वाध्याय और सभी कर्मों को त्यागकर

meaning.en: loincloth, staff, and covering
meaning.hi: कौपीन, दंड और आच्छादन

meaning.en: for sustaining one's own body and for the world's benefit
meaning.hi: अपने शरीर के निर्वाह के लिए और लोक के कल्याण के लिए

meaning.en: this person is the foremost, the highest
meaning.hi: यही मुख्य है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: na dandam na shikham na yajnopavitam na cha achchhadanam charati paramahamsah

meaning.en: the Paramahamsa keeps no staff, tuft, sacred thread, or covering
meaning.hi: परमहंस न दंड, न शिखा, न यज्ञोपवीत, न आच्छादन रखता है

meaning.en: free of the six surging waves of embodied life
meaning.hi: षडूर्मि से मुक्त

meaning.en: envy, pride, jealousy, hypocrisy, arrogance, hatred, desire, anger, greed, delusion, excitement
meaning.hi: निंदा, गर्व, मत्सर, दंभ, दर्प, इच्छा, द्वेष, सुख-दुख, काम, क्रोध, लोभ, मोह, हर्ष

meaning.en: one's own body is seen like an abandoned corpse
meaning.hi: अपना शरीर लाश की तरह देखा जाता है

words.sanskrit: tam shantam achalam advaya-ananda-vijnana-ghana eva asmi

meaning.en: that peaceful, unshakable, non-dual mass of bliss and knowledge, I myself am
meaning.hi: वह शांत, अचल, अद्वय आनंद-विज्ञानघन मैं ही हूँ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: that itself is my highest abode
meaning.hi: वही मेरा परम धाम है

words.sanskrit: tad eva shikha cha tad eva upavitam cha

meaning.en: that itself is my tuft, and that itself is my sacred thread
meaning.hi: वही मेरी शिखा है और वही यज्ञोपवीत है

meaning.en: through the knowledge of the oneness of Supreme Self and self
meaning.hi: परमात्मा और आत्मा के एकत्व-ज्ञान से

words.sanskrit: tayor bheda eva vibhagnah sa sadhya

meaning.en: the difference between them is dissolved; that itself is the true practice
meaning.hi: दोनों का भेद घुल जाता है, वही साध्य है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: giving up all desires, the highest state is reached in non-duality
meaning.hi: सभी इच्छाओं को त्यागकर अद्वैत में परम स्थिति

meaning.en: one who holds the staff of knowledge
meaning.hi: जो ज्ञान-दंड धारण करता है

meaning.en: is said to be the true one-staff holder
meaning.hi: वही एकदंडी कहलाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: one who holds a wooden staff while devoid of knowledge
meaning.hi: जो लकड़ी की छड़ी धारण करता है ज्ञान से रहित होकर

meaning.en: goes to terrible hells known as the great Raurava
meaning.hi: वह महारौरव नामक घोर नरकों में जाता है

meaning.en: knowing this crucial distinction, one becomes a true Paramahamsa
meaning.hi: इस भेद को जानकर वह परमहंस होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: na namaskaro na svadhakaro na ninda na stutih

meaning.en: no formal salutation, no ritual offering-cry, no blame, no praise
meaning.hi: न नमस्कार, न स्वधाकार, न निंदा, न स्तुति

meaning.en: the wandering seeker who becomes whatever circumstance calls for
meaning.hi: यादृच्छिक भिक्षु

words.sanskrit: na avahanam na visarjanam na mantram na dhyanam na upasanam

meaning.en: no invocation, no closing rite, no mantra, no meditation, no worship
meaning.hi: न आवाहन, न विसर्जन, न मंत्र, न ध्यान, न उपासना

meaning.en: homelessness itself is the wandering seeker's way of living
meaning.hi: अनिकेत स्थिति ही भिक्षु का जीवन है

words.sanskrit: yasmad bhikshuh hiranyam rasena drishtam cha

meaning.en: if the seeker looks at gold and is moved by its gleam
meaning.hi: यदि भिक्षु सोने को रस से देखे

meaning.en: that alone undoes everything, striking at the self
meaning.hi: वह सब कुछ बिगाड़ देता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yasmad bhikshuh hiranyam rasena grahyam cha sa atma-ha bhavet

meaning.en: whoever as a seeker is captivated by gold's gleam has harmed their own self
meaning.hi: जो भिक्षु सोने के रस से मोहित हो वह आत्महा है

words.sanskrit: tasmad bhikshuh hiranyam rasena na drishtam cha na sprishtam cha na grahyam cha

meaning.en: therefore the seeker should not look at, touch, or accept gold
meaning.hi: इसलिए भिक्षु सोने को न देखे, न छुए, न ग्रहण करे

meaning.en: all desires that arise in the mind eventually turn back and fade
meaning.hi: मन में उठने वाली सभी इच्छाएँ अंततः पलट जाती हैं

words.sanskrit: duhkhe na udvignah sukhe na spriha tyago rage

meaning.en: not troubled by pain, not longing for pleasure, free of clinging even in letting go
meaning.hi: दुख में अविचलित, सुख की लालसा नहीं, त्याग में भी अनासक्त

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the outward movement of all the senses comes to rest
meaning.hi: सभी इंद्रियों की गति उपरत हो जाती है

meaning.en: one who is established entirely in one's own self
meaning.hi: जो आत्मा में ही स्थित हो जाता है

meaning.en: the single unbroken awareness of complete fullness
meaning.hi: पूर्णानंदैकबोध

words.sanskrit: tad brahmaham asmi iti kritakrityo bhavati kritakrityo bhavati

meaning.en: 'I am that Brahman' — thus one has accomplished all there was to accomplish
meaning.hi: 'मैं वही ब्रह्म हूँ' — इस प्रकार वह कृतकृत्य होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
